news.title: Revolut创始人拟推出由AI驱动的风投基金 - TyN Magazine
news.snippet: Revolut创始人计划设立一只由AI技术驱动的新风险投资基金，以提升投资决策效率。
news.raw_snippet: * English Content Revolut founder set to launch venture capital fund powered by artificial intelligence. # Revolut founder set to launch venture capital fund powered by artificial intelligence. Revolut founder Nik Storonsky is set to launch his own venture capital fund, powered by artificial intelligence. The new venture — dubbed QuantumLight Capital — will be worth around $200 million, with funds supplied by Storonsky and other investors, Forbes reported on Tuesday. “We are built as a technology company by a team of tech unicorn founders, quant traders, AI scientists and engineers,” the QuantumLight website states. The fund will identify investment opportunities using a machine called Aleph as its “proprietary quantitative decision engine.”. According to Forbes, QuantumLight will be focused mainly on Series B and Series C rounds, based on software which eliminates “human judgement.” Storonsky argues that the model is designed to eliminate the clubby world of venture capital, where decisions are made through a crowd mentality. The neobank founder has spent the last year building a team of data scientists and engineers to browse LinkedIn, corporate filings and other public databases in order to identify fast-growing startups. He will also hire in a CEO to head up the fund, according to the Forbes report. The move comes at a time of global expansion for Revolut. In recent months it has acquired banking licenses in at least 10 European countries as it has touted adding new products to it roster, such as home loans and buy-now-pay-later. It has also tussled with UK regulators over anti-money laundering requirements for its crypto products. It is still on the Financial Conduct Authority’s so-called temporary register, alongside crypto custodian Copper and three other firms. The register is a stopgap measure the FCA created after missing an earlier deadline to green-light companies’ operations. Their fate remains uncertain, but without full registration they could in theory be forced to stop crypto-related activities in the UK. ##### Relative altcoin weakness masks early internal rotation. ##### Block Scholes crypto options data comes to Bloomberg terminal to ‘Build Bridge’ for financial institutions. ##### China’s solar energy set to overtake coal, but new coal rush threatens ‘historic’ shift.

news.title: Salesforce CEO称将招聘2000人专门销售AI产品
news.snippet: Salesforce CEO表示公司将新增约2000名销售人员，专门负责AI产品的推广与市场拓展。
news.raw_snippet: # Salesforce to hire 2,000 for AI product sales, says CEO Marc Benioff. 1. Salesforce to Hire 2,000 Salespeople for AI Expansion. 2. Salesforce’s AI Push Following 2022 Layoffs. * CEO Marc Benioff announced that Salesforce will add 2,000 new employees to sell its artificial intelligence products, doubling initial hiring plans. * The new sales team will help promote Salesforce’s upcoming AI software, including the second version of its Agentforce platform, launching in February 2025. * Following layoffs in 2022, Salesforce is now focusing on growing its AI capabilities and expanding its workforce. **Salesforce is set to hire 2,000 new salespeople to focus on selling artificial intelligence (AI) products, doubling its initial hiring plans as the company prepares to launch its next-generation AI agent software in February 2025.**. Salesforce plans to hire 2,000 new salespeople to focus on selling artificial intelligence (AI) products as the company planning to expand its AI offerings. ### Salesforce to Hire 2,000 Salespeople for AI Expansion. A month ago, Benioff mentioned that Salesforce would hire 1,000 new salespeople for AI roles. Salesforce aims to make AI a key part of its product lineup, with AI tools to help sales teams, marketers, and customer service agents do their jobs more efficiently. The new salespeople will help introduce and sell Salesforce’s latest AI technology, including the upcoming second version of its Agentforce platform. This software is designed to create AI-powered agents to handle complex tasks, like answering questions in Salesforce’s Slack app using all available data. Benioff is very excited about Salesforce’s potential for AI. In a recent interview, he shared, *“I’ve never been more excited about anything at Salesforce, maybe in my career.”* He added that he expects the company to have over a billion AI agents within the next year. ### Salesforce’s AI Push Following 2022 Layoffs. Salesforce’s move into AI comes after the company laid off over 7,000 employees in 2022. With its new AI agents and expanded sales team, Salesforce is aiming to become a major player in the AI industry. ### Stay on top of crypto news, get daily updates in your inbox. ## - The Crypto newsletter that keeps you ahead -.
